extracted.intended_audience: administrative law scholars, policy researchers, agency practitioners, and librarians
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of named ACUS recommendations, statements, and report titles listed in an ACUS bibliography / subject index (references to agency procedures, rulemaking, adjudication, FOIA, etc.). Useful for researchers locating ACUS guidance on administrative-law topics.
